svg.title: Quark composition of the nucleons and pions
svg.desc: The proton is uud, the neutron udd, the positive pion u and anti-d, and the negative pion anti-u and d, each quark with its color and spin. Below each, the quark spins add to the particle spin (1/2 for the nucleons, 0 for the pions) and the quark charges add to its charge: +2/3 + 2/3 − 1/3 = 1 for the proton, +2/3 − 1/3 − 1/3 = 0 for the neutron, +2/3 + 1/3 = +1 for the positive pion, and −2/3 − 1/3 = −1 for the negative pion.
